title: Wood2 Solo #39 (목재 솔로 · olive wood · 체형 BBW bombshell · 인종 Japanese · 메이크업 걸크러시(강화) · 배경 야외 테라스 · 힐 숫자 없음 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, late 30s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, wolf cut natural black hair — full body golden olive wood carved directly over her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, this is solid carved wood curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING golden olive wood grain across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID dark-brown swirling figure running between the carved sections, with fine gold inlay lines tracing every joint between the sections, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: leaning a shoulder against the doorway, one knee bent, a hand on her thigh — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals carved from the same olive wood, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, carved from the same olive wood with a high polish.
Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT carved — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.

Background: a sunlit open-air stone terrace at midday with a pale paved floor, a waist-high balustrade, potted palms and a full-height wooden door behind her, bright blue sky overhead, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
